measurementBoundary: Measured locally from the 2026-09-02 active checkout and from the GitHub Actions artifact API. Browser values describe Borg's initial 4K app load without starting an EOM run or selecting a generated record. The monthly Pages estimate is an inferred planning scenario, not observed traffic. EOM solver throughput remains a separately owned, unmeasured field and cannot affect deployment status.

bundleSizeBytes.method: Encoded HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and WASM bytes requested by the fresh Borg first-screen browser load.

staticAssetTransferBytes.method: Encoded non-shell bytes requested by the fresh Borg first-screen load; the two requested KaTeX fonts were the only such resources.

githubPagesBandwidthEstimate.method: Inferred planning scenario: 1,000 uncached first-screen visits multiplied by the measured encoded initial-load bytes. Record selection and repeat-visit cache behavior are excluded.

browserHeapBudget.method: Chrome performance.memory used heap after initial Borg load and a two-second settlement interval.

gpuMemoryBudget.method: Canvas color backing-store lower bound at 3840 by 2160 CSS pixels; excludes depth, textures, geometry, driver allocation, compositor copies, and shared GPU-process memory.

browserStorageBudget.method: navigator.storage.estimate origin usage after the initial Borg load.

actionsArtifactBudget.method: Sum of non-expired GitHub Actions artifacts. The conservative aggregate threshold applies while the account allowance is unknown.

generatedOutputBudget.method: Fresh empty-directory Pages build plus direct byte counts of the generated equation corpus, full corpus index, and Borg record set.

nativeSolverThroughput.reason: Static hosting and browser deployment measurements cannot establish EOM solver steps, rows, candidates, or retained records per second.
